MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 14

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
